name: mind-the-mug
description: A kind reminder for Claude Code: don't delegate your reasoning, or you'll get a mug. Once a day, after the last response of a turn, a small pixel-art cat shows up above the prompt and knocks something off its shelf. It stays until your next prompt.

show.title: When it shows
show.description: daily: once a day, after the first answer of the day. always: after every answer. off: never. It always stays until your next prompt. Same as /mascot daily | always | off.

mascot.title: Mascot
mascot.description: cat: Shelf Life. dog: Fetch. hen: Hatch. lake: Catch of the Day. oven: Proof. random: a different one each time. Same as /mascot <name>.
